mechanism: Concrete Instantiation: Given abstract principle, substitute specific values for variables. {{check}} all constraints still hold after substitution. Generate multiple specializations to understand the principle's range. Edge cases reveal hidden assumptions. The canonical form of {{deduction}} in sema's reasoning taxonomy — necessary conclusions from general premises. Inverse of {{generalize}}.
failure_modes: {{context}} Mismatch: Applying a valid principle to a domain where its preconditions do not hold.
invariants: Constraint Inheritance: Must satisfy all constraints of the general principle
Type Narrowing: Input parameters are a subset of the general domain
